verdict.rationale: Docusaurus produces a static `build` directory that can be deployed to hosts like Vercel, Netlify, Render and Surge, so per-PR previews depend on third-party hosting or CI rather than anything Docusaurus provides itself. Its own documented preview (`start`/`serve`) is local only. One community report of large-site builds timing out on GitHub Actions also suggests per-PR CI builds can be slow. missing for 10: any documented per-pull-request preview deployment workflow, shareable preview URLs, first-party CI/PR integration guidance, independent corroboration of a working PR-preview setup
